populationHeaderGeometryDiagnosis.diagnosis: The OCR header labels and their raw boxes sit in the PDF-vector cells; the frozen HTML header tree swapped the non-Thai and total parent paths. PDF vector topology shows Thai 3 columns, non-Thai 3 columns, and total one column spanning two header rows. This is a table-projection/header-binding defect; the 23 numeric differences are separate OCR recognition errors.

economyPdfVectorAndRowEvidence.finding: The PDF has a matched outer table boundary and readable text words, but the vector detector does not recover the month-cell grid. Text line grouping and horizontal proximity to month header centers support row context; they do not create unique month cell bounds. All 87 economy cells remain unresolved for cell-level mapping.

collateralOutsideHeld239.scope: Population PDF pageIndex1 only; 30 additional resolved-cell mismatch candidates outside the held239 primary denominator.
collateralOutsideHeld239.visualFinding: All 30 original rendered cell crops visually match their clean native PDF numeric text token; this does not generalize to the other 65 of 95 outside-cohort candidates.

limits: This audit does not establish semantic facts, source truth beyond the original PDF glyphs, or graph admission.
The 23 population value differences and 30 collateral differences are separate PDF-derived evidence only; no Paddle OCR output was edited.
Economy PDF row text does not provide unique vertical month-cell boundaries; no per-cell economy correction or binding is asserted.
The other 65 outside-cohort population mismatch candidates (43 pageIndex0 and 22 pageIndex2) were not visually reviewed here and require the separate collateral review.
